summary: Completed backend testing and code review for Iteration 18 - All 9 backend tests passed. Verified: Leaderboard timeframe filter (all-time, this-week, this-month), Dinner planner suggest/weekly-plan/regenerate, AI meal plan. Code review confirms frontend fixes are correctly implemented.

P0 - Chore Filter Chips: Styles at line 928 show compact padding (paddingHorizontal: 10, paddingVertical: 4, marginRight: 6).
P0 - Rewards 'Go to Earn' link: Shop tab has link at line 369-376 that calls setActiveTab('earn'). Earn tab has 'Go to Chores' link at line 432-449 that navigates to Chores screen.
P0 - Theme Custom Mode: enableCustomMode() properly sets isCustomMode=true, saves to AsyncStorage. updateColor() checks both isCustomMode and theme.mode === 'custom'.
P1 - Leaderboard Timeframe: Backend endpoint at line 1770-1826 correctly filters by timeframe. Frontend at line 75-88 has UI selector and re-fetches on change.
P1 - Location Coordinates: openNavigationToChild() at line 421-434 and openMaps() call at line 658-662 both handle lat/lng and latitude/longitude formats.
P1 - Dinner Regenerate: Button at line 312-325 calls handleGetWeeklyPlan() which works correctly (verified by backend tests).
